# Vendored Haotian verl/GDPO runtime

This directory contains the runtime used by the DARA training entry point.
Use the repository root README and docs/TRAINING.md for the fixed experiment
recipe. Install with `pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation -e vendor/verl`
after installing the locked training dependencies.

The underlying verl implementation is Apache-2.0. Original copyright notices
are retained in the source files. See ../../THIRD_PARTY.md for provenance.
